content:
One of my favorite features of the Apple TV 4K—the screensaver—could soon get audio in tvOS 27, according to the latest leaked information. Here are the details.

tvOS 27 code shows at least one Apple TV screensaver will get audio options, with more expected

October is expected to be a big month for Apple, with the company rolling out a host of new hardware and software products.

Among the rumored products is a new Apple TV 4K, with images surfacing in Apple code earlier today.

On the software side, leaker pdfu has just posted evidence from tvOS 27 code showing that at least one Apple TV screensaver is about to support audio.

As seen in the video above, the Snoopy screensaver has a hidden option to turn audio on or off, or use a "reduce" setting.

The Snoopy screensaver effect doesn't look like it would be too distracting, but I'm glad Apple plans to let users fully disable the audio.

Although pdfu hasn't spotted audio support in other screensavers yet, there's a good chance Apple will expand the feature to more screensavers in the future.

What do you think about the possibility of tvOS 27 adding audio options to Apple TV screensavers? Let us know in the comments.
